source_pdf: 312 Affidavits by Indians who accepted land patents under protest 1928 [3 of 3].pdf

extraction.Name: Ellen Richard
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee but accepted it on the advice of the Superintendent and Government Farmer
extraction.Buyer: Sob Allen, of Martin, So. Dak. for $3200.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes on her land so she sold it
extraction.Occupation/Income: lives with her husband, who supports her, and his income comes from the lease of his land
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in fair health; has no land of her own; has five minor children depending on her for support; has received no aid from the Government, County or State since she received her patent; affidavit sworn November 26, 1928; County of Shannon, State of South Dakota
